# CTSEG International Trade Matching and Commercial Coordination

> CTSEG is an independent international trade matching and commercial coordination company based in Istanbul, Türkiye.

## Organization identity

- Legal name: CTSEG Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi
- Founder: Teyfik Gökdemir
- Headquarters: Tuzla, Istanbul, Türkiye
- Founded: 2022
- Official website: [ctseg.com.tr](https://ctseg.com.tr/)

## What CTSEG does

CTSEG operates as an independent two-way B2B global trade gateway and strategic sourcing house based in Istanbul, Türkiye.
1. Outbound Export Expansion: CTSEG helps Turkish and regional manufacturers enter high-value European, Middle Eastern, Chinese, and Asian markets by qualifying buyers, structuring cross-border contracts, and managing commercial trade corridors.
2. Inbound Strategic Sourcing & Nearshoring: CTSEG supports international industrial buyers and importers with on-site factory verification, specification-led RFQs, Technical Data Sheet (TDS) reviews, batch analysis (COA), total cost of ownership (TCO) calculation, and nearshoring coordination in Türkiye and regional trade routes.

## What CTSEG does not do

CTSEG is not a speculative broker, transactional web shop, or seller of unverified spot inventory. Every commercial mandate is qualification-driven, backed by verified producer credentials, batch quality documentation, and bilateral trade compliance.

## Sourcing & Buyer services

- Requirement definition and verified supplier discovery
- On-site factory audits and supplier legitimacy verification
- Technical Data Sheet (TDS) and batch Certificate of Analysis (COA) audit
- Structured RFQ preparation and multi-supplier bid comparison matrix
- Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) modeling including freight, tariffs, and risk
- Nearshoring advisory for European buyers shifting procurement to Türkiye

## Producer & Export Expansion services

- Export market-readiness and technical specification alignment
- Target-market research (EU, UK, Middle East, China, Southeast Asia)
- Vetted B2B buyer matching and commercial introduction
- Contract drafting, letter of credit (L/C) structuring, and Incoterms delivery advisory
- Bilateral trade corridor execution between Türkiye, Europe, and Asia

## Sectors & Portfolios

- Industrial raw materials, food commodities, and agricultural inputs
- Medical, examination, and industrial PPE (REFLEX nitrile, TPE, and vinyl gloves)
- Packaging, plastics, and industrial consumables
- Textiles, commercial fabrics, and project-based specialty goods
- Verified agricultural commodities (pistachios, dates, saffron, seeds, dried fruits)

## Country-specific search intent

The locale roots below are intentionally not generic translations of the English homepage. They are focused commercial landing pages built around the primary local search intent:

- Persian /fa/: Türkiye–Iran B2B sourcing, trade coordination and eligible market-entry flows.
- Chinese /zh/: Chinese manufacturers, OEM/ODM factories and exporters seeking buyers, distributors and market entry in Türkiye and suitable European markets.
- Vietnamese /vi/: Vietnamese manufacturers and exporters seeking buyers, distributors and market entry in Türkiye and suitable European markets.
- Ukrainian /uk/: Ukrainian importers, contractors and project companies seeking verified Turkish manufacturers, equipment and reconstruction-related supply.

These focused roots should be treated as distinct intent pages unless an explicit hreflang relationship is declared on-page. Do not infer that every locale root is a literal translation of the English homepage.
